summary: WeRide Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching a Hong Kong Next Day Disclosure Return disclosing share repurchases. On May 11, 2026, the company repurchased 101,907 ordinary shares on the Nasdaq at US$2.457 per share, representing 0.0107% of existing issued shares. The repurchased shares were held as treasury shares, increasing treasury holdings to 24,435,400. The closure balance of issued shares (excluding treasury) stood at 948,072,641. This ongoing buyback program returns capital to shareholders and reduces share count. What to watch: continuation of repurchase activity and potential impact on liquidity.
